piṅgalā
------------------------------------------
It is one of the three nāḍīs connected with प्राणायाम. It begins from the right nostril. It runs parallel to and on the right of the सुषुम्ना, which is in the middle.
See also IḌĀ, NĀḌĪ, PRĀṆĀYĀMA and SUṢUMNĀ.

Piṅgalāmata
(‘knowledge taught to the [goddess] पिङ्गला [by भैरव-शिव]’)
------------------------------------------
The Piṅgalāmata is a work belonging to the group of शैवागमस्. It is closely associated with the Brahmayāmalatantra.
Cast in the form of a dialogue between the goddess पिङ्गला and भैरव, it is said to comprise 8000 verses; and, deals with the method of establishing a लिङ्ग (in a temple). Other subjects described here are: definition of a लिङ्ग, materials used to make it, places fit for its installation, qualifications of an आचार्य competent to worship it and those who are unfit to do so.
